description: How this app computes PPh 21, and the gate that says its rate tables have been checked.

fields.label: Enable PPh 21 on Salary Slips
fields.description: Off by default. Nothing is computed until this is on.

fields.label: PPh 21 Salary Component
fields.description: The deduction row this app writes. Must NOT be flagged 'Variable Based On Taxable Salary' — that hands the calculation to HRMS's annualised slab engine, which cannot express TER.

fields.label: Rate tables verified against the regulation
fields.description: PPh 21 refuses to compute until this is ticked. A blocked payroll run is a far better failure than a silently wrong withholding.

fields.label: Source / Provenance
fields.description: Where the loaded tables came from.

fields.label: Biaya Jabatan Monthly Cap
fields.description: Rp 500,000 per month, i.e. Rp 6,000,000 for a full year.

name: EIL PPh 21 Settings
